messages.english: Review conflicting shape versions on your map.
messages.translation: Kambisisa tivhezheni ta swivumbeko leti lwisanaka eka mepe wa wena.
Kambisisa tivhezheni ta swivumbeko swa mepe
Mepe → Swivumbeko leswi lavaka xiboho xa wena

messages.english: Open the list of shapes needing a decision. Review each preserved version before choosing which to keep, or keep both when offered. Download a backup when the map offers one; older app versions still need care.
messages.translation: Pfula nxaxamelo wa swivumbeko leswi lavaka xiboho. Kambisisa vhezheni yin’wana na yin’wana leyi hlayisiweke u nga si hlawula leyi u faneleke ku yi hlayisa, kumbe u hlayisa ha timbirhi loko swi nyikiwile. Dawuniloda khophi yo hlayisa loko mepe wu yi nyika; tivhezheni ta khale ta apu ta ha lava vukheta.
